findings.title: Off-by-one: loop sums n+1 items instead of n
findings.rationale: Diff line `+  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {` (now at line 4 of src/sum.js) changes `<` to `<=`, so the loop iterates n+1 times, contradicting the comment "Sum the first n items". When n >= items.length, items[n] is undefined and total becomes NaN.
findings.failure_scenario: sumFirst([1,2,3], 3) returns NaN (1+2+3+undefined); sumFirst([1,2,3], 2) returns 6 instead of 3.
findings.suggested_fix: Revert to `for (let i = 0; i < n; i++)`, optionally clamping with Math.min(n, items.length).
